newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesian ship bursts into flames, three rescued.
newsitem.headline: Indonesian ship bursts into flames, three rescued.

text.p: An Indonesian cargo ship burst into flames while being repaired at the main Jakarta port on Monday, but three crew aboard were rescued, port officials said.

Sujarwo, head of the Tanjung Priok port's marketing and public affairs department, said tugs had towed the 2,566-tonne MT Wakeke seven km (four miles) from the port. But he said the vessel, owned by PT Pejaka, was still ablaze.
"Three crew who were in the ship were rescued unhurt," he told Reuters. "There was an explosion, but nobody was hurt."
Sujarwo said the cause of the fire was not immediately known. There was no cargo aboard the vessel.
Another official said the ship burst into flames while undergoing repairs at the docks.
